root: ^Saga, I think I found a journal from someone in your family. At least that's what it looks like.
^Is that so? Let me see it.
^Hmm.. This sure does sound like someone from my family, doesn't seem like they're happy about it though.
^Mmhm, but I don't recognise their name, so they are definitely before my time.
^But even still… I constantly got told about my predecessors and their accomplishments. Most of their names are practically engraved in my head.
^But I guess Adrien here was never worth talking about. Poor guy…
^Well, I'm at least happy you didn't have to share their fate.
